items.title: Annihilation of Caste
items.description: Annihilation of Caste is an undelivered speech written in 1936 by Dr. B. R. Ambedkar for the annual conference of Jat-Pat Todak Mandal in Lahore. It is a landmark work critically analyzing the caste system and arguing for its complete destruction.

items.title: Dr. BabaSaheb Ambedkar
items.description: A biographical film about Dr. B. R. Ambedkar covering his early education, higher studies, legal career, political work, Mahad Satyagraha, social reform activities and later life.
